entries.toelichting: Son of Barzillai (2Sam 19:37,38,40; Jer 41:17). English convention: Chimham.
Moabite deity (Num 21:29; Judg 11:24; 1Kgs 11:7,33; 2Kgs 23:13; Jer 48:7,13,46). English convention: Chemosh.
Ni: be-warm-and-tender of inwards (Gen 43:30; 1Kgs 3:26; Lam 5:10; Hos 11:8). Hyphenated.
Pagan-priest (2Kgs 23:5; Hos 10:5; Zeph 1:4). Hyphenated to mark idolatrous-priest distinct from H3548 kohen YHWH-priest.
Adverbial 'so, thus, therefore' (~707 occurrences). Standard concordant.
Adjective: right, fitting (Gen 42:11,19,31,33,34; Ex 10:29; Num 27:7; 36:5). Hyphenated.
Variant of Jeconiah/Jehoiachin (Jer 22:24,28; 37:1). English convention: Coniah.
Levite chief musician (1Chr 15:22,27; 26:29). English convention: Chenaniah. 'YHWH-establishes'.
Qal/Pi/Hithp: collect, gather (1Chr 22:2; Esth 4:16; Ecc 2:8,26; 3:5; Ps 33:7; Isa 28:20; 33:4; Eze 22:21; 39:28). Hyphenated.
By metonymy (Phoenicians as traders): Job 40:30; Hos 12:8; Zeph 1:11. Standard concordant.
Father of Zedekiah and Benjamite (1Kgs 22:11,24; 1Chr 7:10; 2Chr 18:10,23). English convention: Chenaanah.
By extension; Prov 31:24; Isa 23:8; Hos 12:7; Zeph 1:11. Standard concordant.
Sea and city (Num 34:11; Deut 3:17; Josh 11:2; 12:3; 13:27; 19:35; 1Kgs 15:20). English convention: Chinnereth.
Lev 3:4,10,15; 4:9; 7:4; Job 8:14; 15:27; 31:24; Ps 49:13; 78:7; Prov 3:26; Ecc 7:25. Hyphenated to mark dual aspect.
Ninth month (Neh 1:1; Zech 7:1). Hyphenated. English convention: Chislev.
Father of Elidad (Num 34:21). English convention: Chislon.
Border-town of Judah (Josh 15:10). English convention: Chesalon.
Zebulun town (Josh 19:12). Hyphenated. English convention: Chisloth-tabor.
Ni: yearn (Gen 31:30; Ps 17:12; 84:2; Job 14:15; Zeph 2:1). Hyphenated.
Silver-metal, silver-coinage (~403 occurrences spanning all OT). Hyphenated to mark dual aspect of metal-and-money.
Place where Iddo lived (Ezr 8:17). English convention: Casiphia.
Sub-sense; emotional-pain (Job 6:2; Prov 17:25; Ecc 1:18). Standard concordant.
Hollow-of-hand, also sole-of-foot, ladle, pan (~191 occurrences across OT). Hyphenated; distinguished from H3027 yad hand-as-power.
Hivite-then-Benjamite town (Josh 9:17; 18:26; Ezr 2:25; Neh 7:29). English convention: Chephirah.
Substitute-payment (Ex 21:30; 30:12; Num 35:31,32; 1Sam 12:3; Job 33:24; 36:18; Ps 49:7; Prov 6:35; 13:8; 21:18; Isa 43:3; Amos 5:12). Standard concordant.
Benjamite village (Josh 18:24). Hyphenated. English convention: Chephar-haammoni.

Solid-gold lid above the ark (Ex 25:17-22; 26:34; 30:6; 31:7; 35:12; 37:6-9; 39:35; 40:20; Lev 16:2,13,14,15; Num 7:89; 1Chr 28:11). Hyphenated; KJV 'mercy-seat' is theological-paraphrase, kapporet from kapar = covering-of-atonement.
Origin of the Philistines (Deut 2:23; Jer 47:4; Amos 9:7). English convention: Caphtor.
Babylonian place (Ezr 2:59; Neh 7:61). English convention: Cherub.
Brook where Elijah hid (1Kgs 17:3,5). English convention: Cherith.
City on the Euphrates (2Chr 35:20; Isa 10:9; Jer 46:2). English convention: Carchemish.
Eunuch of Ahasuerus (Esth 1:10). English convention: Carcas.
Reubenite and Judahite (Gen 46:9; Ex 6:14; Num 26:6; Josh 7:1,18; 1Chr 2:7; 4:1; 5:3). English convention: Carmi.
David's bodyguard (1Sam 30:14; 2Sam 8:18; 15:18; 20:7,23; 1Kgs 1:38,44; 1Chr 18:17; Eze 25:16; Zeph 2:5). English convention: Cherethite.
Son of Nahor (Gen 22:22). English convention: Chesed.
Pi: bewitch (Ex 7:11; Deut 18:10; 2Chr 33:6; Dan 2:2; Mal 3:5). Hyphenated.
Inscription, document (1Chr 28:19; 2Chr 2:11; 35:4; Ezr 2:62; 4:7; Neh 7:64; Esth 1:22; 3:14; 4:8; 8:8,9,13; 9:27; Eze 13:9; Dan 10:21). Hyphenated.
Cyprus, by extension Mediterranean coastlands (Gen 10:4; Num 24:24; 1Chr 1:7; Isa 23:1,12; Jer 2:10; Eze 27:6; Dan 11:30). English convention: Kittim.
Town of Judah (Josh 15:40). English convention: Chitlish.
Pi/Hi: encompass (Judg 20:43; Ps 22:12; 142:7; Hab 1:4; Job 36:2; Prov 14:18). Hyphenated.
Top of pillar (Ex 36:38; 38:17,19,28; 1Kgs 7:16-42; 2Kgs 25:17; 2Chr 3:15; 4:12,13; Jer 52:22). Standard concordant.

Qal/Pi/Pu/Hi/Hophal: beat-fine, break-in-pieces (Num 11:8; 14:45; Deut 1:44; 9:21; 1Sam 13:7 (?); 2Kgs 18:4; 2Chr 15:6; 34:7; Ps 89:23; Isa 2:4; 24:12; 30:14; Jer 46:5; Mic 1:7; 4:3; Joel 3:10; Zech 11:6). Hyphenated.
Standard negation (~5189 occurrences across all OT — the most-frequent absolute negation in Hebrew). Standard concordant 'not'.
Trans-Jordanian town (2Sam 9:4,5; 17:27; Amos 6:13). Hyphenated. English convention: Lo-debar. 'Not-a-thing'.
Son of Dedan (Gen 25:3). English convention: Leummim.

Inner-being, mind, will, emotion-seat (~601 occurrences spanning all OT — the most-frequent inner-faculty noun in Hebrew). Standard concordant 'heart' covers cognitive, emotional, volitional, and moral senses.
Cipher for Babylon (Jer 51:1). Hyphenated. English convention: Leb-kamai. 'Heart-of-those-rising-against-me'.
Variant of lev (~252 occurrences). Standard concordant 'heart'.
Town near Shiloh (Judg 21:19). English convention: Lebonah.
Hi/Hithp: become-white (Ps 51:7; Isa 1:18; Joel 1:7; Dan 11:35; 12:10). Hyphenated.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:45; Neh 7:48). English convention: Lebanah.
Wilderness station and Levitical city (Num 33:20,21; Josh 10:29-39; 12:15; 15:42; 21:13; 2Kgs 8:22; 19:8; 23:31; 24:18; 1Chr 6:57; 2Chr 21:10; Isa 37:8; Jer 52:1). English convention: Libnah.
Gen 11:3; Ex 1:14; 5:7,8,16,18,19; Isa 9:10; 65:3; Eze 4:1. Standard concordant.
Town in Judah (1Chr 8:12; Ezr 2:33; Neh 7:37; 11:35). English convention: Lod.
Sword-blade and flame (Gen 3:24; Judg 3:22; 1Sam 17:7; Job 39:23; 41:21; Nah 3:3; Isa 13:8; 66:15; Jer 47:6). Hyphenated.
Qal/Pi: kindle, scorch (Deut 32:22; Job 41:21; Ps 57:4; 83:14; 97:3; 104:4; 106:18; Joel 1:19; 2:3; Mal 4:1). Hyphenated.
